projectContent.text:
Originally released by Pinhas Dagan (MIA) in 1983, this T-shirt is said to have been sent to Menachem Begin, the Israeli Prime Minister at the time. The T-shirt was produced with the naive intent to distribute it all across Israel, hoping it would end the ongoing violence at the time–at least as stated by its creator in “This World” Magazine (העולם הזה) article from 1983.

“This World” Issue No 2379 - 6.4.1983
